g.title: legend
g.text: • NAME-FIRST: n = fn_name.to_lowercase(); match against canonical name SETS.
• SELECTOR bytes used for ONE arm only — Chainlink via is_oracle_interface(&selector).
• ONE param-signature disambiguation — deposit(+address) ⇒ ERC-4626 vault, else Staking.
• PRECEDENCE MATTERS: specific standards (4626/721/1155) tested BEFORE ERC-20 base case,
because transfer/approve/balanceOf are shared → ERC-20 is the deliberate fallthrough.
• Returns Option — first hit wins; no hit ⇒ None ⇒ contract invisible to topology.
• Runs PRE-FLIGHT on the loaded ABIs — zero transactions sent (corpus_initializer.rs:611-649).
